question.en: When is the best time to visit Sri Lanka?
question.zh: 什么时候去斯里兰卡旅游最好？

answer.en: Sri Lanka is a year-round destination thanks to its unique twin monsoon climate. From December to April, the South and West coasts and the Hill Country enjoy sunny, dry weather. From May to September, the East Coast (Pasikudah, Trincomalee) has crystal-clear waters and golden sunshine.
answer.zh: 斯里兰卡全年皆宜旅游。12月至4月是西南部海滩与高山茶园的最佳季节；5月至9月则是东海岸亭可马里等海域的黄金旅游季。

answer.en: Visitors can obtain an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) online prior to arrival via the official Sri Lankan immigration portal. Visas are typically approved within 24 to 48 hours. Our tour executives provide step-by-step assistance with your application.
answer.zh: 游客可通过斯里兰卡官方电子签证系统在线申请ETA电子签证，通常在24至48小时内出签。
